test_item:
Verification of X.509 Leaf Certificate against Trusted Chain
(broken certificate chain; verification is rejected)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. Certificate assets of group X-e (broken variant) are present under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
input: Broken leaf certificate SAMcert.pem whose issuer is absent from the chain, under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the broken leaf certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
2. Run the Cert Provider instrumentation test for the broken certificate flow
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#fotaMcpuCertTestBrokenCert com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
3. Confirm the rejection entry in the Cert Provider log
$ adb logcat -s MelcoCertProviderTest
er:
1. The openssl command prints `error 2 at 0 depth lookup: unable to get issuer certificate` on stdout
2. The instrumentation runner reports `OK (1 test)` for fotaMcpuCertTestBrokenCert
3. `$ adb logcat -s MelcoCertProviderTest` contains `MelcoCertProviderTest: ECU certificate verification broken chain = ERR_UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY`
author: PeiPYHsu
